## Functions!

Start small w Z scores
```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(n=40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec))/sd(x_vec)
```

Let's turn this into a function
```{r}
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if(!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x))/sd(x)
  
  return(z)
  
}
```

Does this actually work??

```{r}
z_scores(x_vec)
z_scores(rpois(4000, lambda = 12))
```

Won't work (don't run on knitting):
```{r, eval = FALSE}
z_scores(iris)
z_scores("my name is emma") 
z_scores(c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE))
z_scores(3)
```

## Motive and write another one!!

```{r}
sim_df = 
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(n=40, mean = 12, sd = 3)
  )

sim_df |> 
  summarize(
    mean = mean(x),
    sd = sd(x)
  )
```
```{r}
source("source/sim_mean_sd.R")
```

```{r}
sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 40, mu = 12, sigma = 3)

sim_mean_sd(50, 12, 3)

sim_mean_sd(mu = 12, n_obs = 40, sigma = 3)

sim_mean_sd(12, n_obs = 40, 3) # also works --> assumes is in right order

sim_mean_sd(50) # if default values are set
```

## Fix things that bother me

This bothered me 

```{r}
# original
fellowship_df = read_excel("data/LoTR_Words.xlsx", range = "B3:D6") |> 
  mutate(movie = "fellowship")

two_tower_df = read_excel("data/LoTR_Words.xlsx", range = "F3:H6") |> 
  mutate(movie = "two_towers")

return_df = read_excel("data/LoTR_Words.xlsx", range = "J3:L6") |> 
  mutate(movie = "return_of_king")

#fixed
source("source/read_lotr.R")

fellowship_df = read_lotr(r = "B3:D6", m = "fellowship")
two_tower_df = read_lotr(r = "F3:H6", m = "two_towers")
return_df = read_lotr(r = "J3:L6", m = "return_of_king")
```

and now it's fixed

```{r}
# original
nsduh_url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"
drug_use_html = read_html(nsduh_url)

marj_df = 
  read_html(nsduh_url) |> 
  html_table() |> 
  nth(1) |>
  slice(-1) |> 
  select(-contains("P Value")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -State,
    names_to = "age_year", 
    values_to = "percent") |>
  separate(age_year, into = c("age", "year"), sep = "\\(") |>
  mutate(
    year = str_replace(year, "\\)", ""),
    percent = str_replace(percent, "[a-c]$", ""),
    percent = as.numeric(percent)) |>
  filter(!(State %in% c("Total U.S.", "Northeast", "Midwest", "South", "West")))

cocaine_df = 
  read_html(nsduh_url) |> 
  html_table() |> 
  nth(4) |>
  slice(-1) |> 
  select(-contains("P Value")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -State,
    names_to = "age_year", 
    values_to = "percent") |>
  separate(age_year, into = c("age", "year"), sep = "\\(") |>
  mutate(
    year = str_replace(year, "\\)", ""),
    percent = str_replace(percent, "[a-c]$", ""),
    percent = as.numeric(percent)) |>
  filter(!(State %in% c("Total U.S.", "Northeast", "Midwest", "South", "West")))

# fixed

source("source/nsduh_process.R")

marj_df = nsduh_process(drug_use_html, 1)
cocaine_df = nsduh_process(drug_use_html, 4)
```
